# PaginationDecision

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

What a pagination primitive decides to do with its child before rendering it on the current page.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type PaginationDecision = 'render'
/**
 * Nothing can be rendered on this page; move to a fresh one and ask again.
 * The pipeline turns this into {@link RenderStatus.WrapRequired}.
 */
 | 'wrap'
/** The child does not appear on this page at all; report completion. */
 | 'skip'
```

## Values

- `"render"`
- `"wrap"`
- `"skip"`
